environment: Owner's personal Windows host; read-only operating-system identity probe
native_or_emulated: Windows and PowerShell report X64; WMI reports an x64-based PC and processor architecture code 9 (AMD64). This is native x64 Windows, not ARM64 x64 emulation. Hypervisor status was not queried.

operating_system.registry_product_name_note: Legacy registry ProductName conflicts with the direct Win32_OperatingSystem.Caption and was not used as OS identification.

procedure: Read Win32_OperatingSystem Caption, Version, BuildNumber, and OSArchitecture through Get-CimInstance.
Read Win32_ComputerSystem SystemType and Win32_Processor Architecture/AddressWidth through Get-CimInstance.
Read CurrentVersion registry EditionID, DisplayVersion, CurrentBuild, UBR, and the legacy ProductName field.

assertions.name: Windows identifies itself as Windows 11 Pro
Windows edition and version/build are recorded
Running OS and process architecture are 64-bit x64/AMD64
assertions.observed: WMI OS 64-bit; CPU architecture code 9; x64-based PC; .NET OS/process X64/X64; PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE AMD64

candidate.execution: Not launched for this OS-identity requirement

side_effects: Read-only system queries only; no application, installer, updater, or uninstaller launched; no user settings or system configuration changed.
limitations: This PASS establishes native Windows 11 x64 OS/architecture identity only. It does not claim application UI behavior, installation/uninstallation, audio, Narrator, notifications, lock/unlock, sleep/resume, or display behavior. The approved bounded application tests remain separately permission-gated because temporary-account creation requires UAC/elevation.
